"''Just fire right there!|An OOM commander and a B1 sergeant|audio=Sector11374265-TCWf.flac|}} A '''B1 battle droid sergeant''' served the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ==History== {{Quote|Get back here, sergeant!|OOM commander after the sergeant fell over the edge|audio=GetBackHereSergeant-TCWf.flac|}} [[File:DeadDroidSergeant.png|thumb|left|200px|The droid sergeant lies destroyed at the base of the mesa]] In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to guard the [[B'omarr Monastery|B'omarr monastery]], where the Separatists were holding [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] kidnapped son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]]. When the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the]] [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] arrived to rescue the Huttlet, the sergeant was the first to spot the approaching Republic [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transports]] which they reported to their [[Unidentified OOM command battle droid (Teth)/Legends|commanding officer]]. However, they expressed confusion when their commander told them to aim at a sector, causing their commander to irritably point at the location. As the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] began, the Republic forces took shelter from Separatist droid fire at the base of the mesa on which the monastery was situated. While trying to locate the enemy troops at the base of the cliff, the sergeant leaned too far over the edge and plummeted to their destruction on the jungle floor below, their goggles falling after them. {{Droid-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== In the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|novelization]] of the film, the droid that falls to the ground from the top of the plateau in front of [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] is a [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|battle droid commander]].[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]] ==Appearances== *[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]] {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:B1-series battle droids]] [[Category:Droids of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Category:Droids with masculine programming]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Separatist officers]]
